test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option for the given group of words.

A person who is neither well experienced nor professional
solution:
The correct answer is **'Amateur'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• First of all, we need to **understand the meaning of the given options.**

 
 
• **Proficient **- *A person who is skilled and experienced.*
 
• **Amateur **- *Someone who does not have much skill in what they do.*
 
• **Expert **- *A person with a high level of knowledge and skill.*
 
• **Veteran **- *A person who has had a lot of experience in a particular activity.*
 
 
 
• If we observe the **above-mentioned meaning**, we get to know that **the word 'Amateur' is the most appropriate **option for the given group of words.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's understand the** word with practical examples:**

 
• My brother is **proficient **in three languages.
 
• He was an **amateur **athlete until the age of 30 when he turned professional.
 
• My wife is an **expert **in bargaining, especially in shopping.
 
• Mr. Verma is one of our **veterans **because he has been teaching for the last thirteen years.
